definition.evidence: example_exports/gls_exported/pixel/dx_5_0/uber (12.1.0 client, all 26 variants): the switch on cb2[4].x that sets diffuse and emissive, and the alpha-test switch that sets alpha

t0.description: The material layer whose texture_unit is 0 (MOMT texture_1), sampled at uv0 unless the draw's environment-mapping flag (cb0[5].y = 1 or 2) replaces it with sphere-mapped coordinates.

t1.description: The material layer whose texture_unit is 1 (MOMT texture_2), sampled at uv1 unless the draw's environment-mapping flag (cb0[5].y = 1 or 2) replaces it with sphere-mapped coordinates.

t2.description: The material layer whose texture_unit is 2 (MOMT texture_3), sampled at uv2.

definition.notes: Alpha is what the shader alpha-tests (128/255, per MSAA sample).
